apps/extension-spectra/src/background/co.rationale: One transaction owner currently preserves target identity, strategy escalation, readback, rollback, revision and sender authorization without cross-module partial commits.
apps/extension-spectra/src/background/co.decompositionTrigger: Split only when a typed transaction sub-owner can retain one revision writer and the full source-by-sender authorization matrix across dynamic and Chrome tests.

apps/extension-spectra/src/content/logic.rationale: Native target selection, browser operation and exact readback share one media identity and rollback boundary.
apps/extension-spectra/src/content/logic.decompositionTrigger: Split a capability family only after its target/readback/rollback contract is executable independently and cannot create a second media selector.

packages/contracts/src/control.contracts.rationale: The exhaustive field, operation, strategy and runtime validation graph is one public contract surface with compile-time totality checks.
packages/contracts/src/control.contracts.decompositionTrigger: Split only along exported contract domains while retaining one index that enforces exhaustive capability and validator coverage.

packages/contracts/src/spectra.protocol..rationale: Request/event envelope definitions and validators remain co-located so a new wire type cannot ship without its runtime validator.
packages/contracts/src/spectra.protocol..decompositionTrigger: Split only when a generated or type-checked registry proves every wire envelope has exactly one exported validator and no circular runtime dependency.
